# Development notes, tool recommendations and archive

> Browse development notes and tool recommendations by topic, with original dates, source attribution and version context.

## Historical context

This collection includes current tool recommendations and historical development notes from 2015–2017. Read each article’s source date and version context; archived notes retain original dates and attribution.
The examples were not rerun for this reorganization. Old Swift syntax, APIs, dependencies, service addresses and App Store rules may be obsolete; check current official documentation before applying them.

## Technical topics

- [UIKit & graphics development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/uikit-graphics/llms.txt): Layout, lists, gestures, rich text, UIView, Core Animation and drawing.
- [Swift & runtime development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/swift-runtime/llms.txt): Swift language notes, Objective-C messaging, KVO, blocks and code organisation.
- [Concurrency & performance development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/concurrency-performance/llms.txt): Threads, RunLoop, keeping a thread alive, UI stalls and performance investigation.
- [Data & networking development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/data-network/llms.txt): Core Data, caching, network requests, messaging, notifications and system services.
- [Tools & releases development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/tooling-release/llms.txt): CocoaPods, Git, static libraries, Xcode, testing, compatibility and release notes.
- [Audio & video development development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/audio-video/llms.txt): Building FFmpeg, H.264 decoding, capture, streaming and player integration.
- [Web & development notes development notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/journal/topics/web-notes/llms.txt): WebView, JavaScript bridges, mini programs, blog maintenance and development reflections.
